output.review_comment: The rounding logic (round to 0.05 boundary first, then to 0.1) appears specifically engineered to satisfy particular tests rather than implementing a general principle. Before merging, please: (1) Confirm all tests pass by providing test output, (2) Update the function docstring or add comprehensive comments explaining why this specific rounding strategy is required per the storage team spec, (3) Verify the Decimal formatting produces exactly the format expected by tests.
